FAIL_TO_PASS: logs: displays logs

generated-code-preset-override: overrides the generatedCode option when using presets
get-chunk-name: get right chunk name for preserve modules
config-external: external option gets passed from config
fail-after-warnings: errors on warnings with --failAfterWarnings

warn-circular: warns for circular dependencies

silent-onwarn: triggers onwarn with --silent
